name: Should I add a full bathroom or a half bathroom in the basement?

mainEntity.name: Should I add a full bathroom or a half bathroom in the basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a full bathroom and a powder room comes down to budget, plumbing access, and how you intend to use the space. A half bathroom requires less square footage, lower fixture costs, and easier rough-in work, making it practical for simple entertainment spaces. A full bathroom demands under-slab drain line trenching for a shower or tub, dedicated ventilation, and higher plumbing expenses. However, a full bath is necessary if you include a guest bedroom or plan to create an independent living suite.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a half bath for lower costs and entertaining convenience. Opt for a full bath if you are building a bedroom, hosting overnight guests, or creating an independent living suite.
